The "'''Junk Armada'''" was a fabled [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of hundreds of decommissioned [[Starship/Legends|starships]] yoked together by [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic fields]] that traveled through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TJA" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Junk Armada" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the Armada was controlled by an eccentric "[[Junk Armada's "admiral"|admiral]]."<ref name="TJA" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the Junk Armada passed through a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] an individual affiliated with one of the factions in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was there.<ref name="TJA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The individual sent a companion to search the Armada for useful items. The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the fleet became fond of the companion and allowed them to search those vessels that remained more intact. The companion subsequently returned from the Junk Armada with a large haul of scrap materials.<ref name="TJA" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Junk Armada was mentioned as part of the Crew Skill Mission "The Junk Armada" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TJA" />
